fields.hero_h1: Emergency Glass Repair in Toronto and the GTA
fields.hero_subhead: Break-ins, storm damage, and accidents, handled fast. We secure the opening and replace the glass, day or night, across the GTA.
fields.overview_heading: Broken glass? We secure it fast
fields.overview_body: SolidGuard provides emergency glass repair across Toronto and the GTA, day or night. Break-ins, storm damage, and accidents: our emergency glass repair team secures the opening fast, then replaces the glass once it is cut to size. We are the emergency glass repair Toronto homes and businesses call after hours, with 24 hour glass repair and board-up across most of the GTA. Police-cleared technicians, and we document the work for your insurance.

faqs.question: How fast can you respond to an emergency?
faqs.answer: We aim to secure most GTA properties the same day, day or night. Call and we will give you a realistic arrival window.

faqs.question: Do you board up and replace, or just one?
faqs.answer: Both. We board up to secure the opening immediately, then return with the cut-to-size glass to finish the repair.

faqs.question: Can you help with an insurance claim?
faqs.answer: Yes. We document the damage and the work so you have what you need for your insurer.
